title: Third Shot Drop (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-folk groove 100 bpm warm acoustic guitar finger snaps melodic bass mellow horn light Spanish phrase accent patient swing-feel pickleball training song artist Michelle Grogan
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Served it deep return came back hot
Now the third shot is the spot you got
Don't drive it dumb don't slap it loose
Soft hands gentle arc let it land in the noose

[Pre-Chorus]
Low bounce slow drop
Knees soft elbows stop

[Chorus]
Third shot drop third shot drop
Let it kiss the kitchen don't let it pop
Patience patience that's the prop
Third shot drop is the move you cop

[Verse 2]
From the baseline to the line
Buy the time make the climb
Paddle face open swing slow
Let the ball decide where to go

[Bridge]
Despacio suave en el aire
Let the rally rebuild from there
Tres tres tres the count goes round
The third shot drop is the patient sound

[Chorus]
Third shot drop third shot drop
Let it kiss the kitchen don't let it pop
Patience patience that's the prop
Third shot drop is the move you cop

[Outro]
Soft hands win the day
Third shot drop the only way
